description: PC-side dashboard profile for direct Ethernet link to the DE1-SoC HPS UDP streamer. This file is hand-written runtime configuration; packet IDs, payload sizes, CSR offsets, and command IDs still come from generated headers/modules.

display.title: T-RECAP Phase 2 Telemetry - DE1-SoC Direct Link

bringup_policy.correctness_authority: BRAM replay plus reference-output artifact comparison
bringup_policy.udp_datagram_rule: one telemetry header plus payload per UDP datagram; DDR padding is not transmitted
bringup_policy.wrap_policy: WRAP is a DDR-ring control record and is not expected on the normal UDP stream
bringup_policy.command_policy: commands are sent only by explicit launcher options or explicit live-control actions through one persistent HPS-mediated command-client session
